Delhi PG building collapses, students displaced

A paying guest (PG) accommodation building collapsed in Delhi, displacing students. The incident has raised concerns about the safety of buildings, particularly in light of recurring accidents. Delhi University colleges have opened their campuses to support the students who were displaced by the collapse. The coverage highlights student concerns about the lack of action on unsafe buildings.
